summary: security checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: conditional for ordinary bounded growth; blocked for security-sensitive go-live, release, or production changes. Evidence: TLS expiry check found no certificates expiring within 30 days, but fleet-doctor has never run, deployment/uptime/error sweeps are unavailable, and no evidence supports authentication boundaries, secret handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency or supply-chain review, data-exposure controls, incident monitoring, or disclosure readiness. Missing evidence is not evidence of safety. Continue only existing reversible workstreams; do not block ordinary growth for optional hardening alone.

Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private. Do not authorize public beta, full launch, notification expansion, credential changes, production configuration changes, or monetization changes until access, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, TLS, data-exposure, monitoring, incident-response, and disclosure-readiness evidence is complete and reviewed. Security-sensitive implementation must include implementation.security_review with status approved or needs_owner, reviewed_by security, and an evidence-backed decision_note.

Risk severity: high for go-live and security-sensitive production changes because fleet-doctor is unavailable and operational security telemetry is missing; medium for ordinary growth because no active incident, credential exposure, exploit, or expiring certificate is evidenced. Missing security.txt or disclosure evidence remains a readiness gap, not proof of vulnerability.
